AI Immigration and News Assistant.name: AI Immigration and News Assistant
AI Immigration and News Assistant.tools: RAG, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Next.js, Docker, OpenAI API
bullets: Built a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistant over 467 documents and 2,894 chunks from the USCIS Policy Manual and Inside Higher Ed, where every answer cites its source and citations are resolved after generation so they cannot be fabricated.

Combined pgvector HNSW search with PostgreSQL full-text search through reciprocal rank fusion and reranking, added query normalization and intent routing, and ingested new content incrementally with content-hash change detection.

University Admission Prediction Pipeline.name: University Admission Prediction Pipeline
University Admission Prediction Pipeline.tools: Python, scikit-learn, Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions
bullets: Built an end-to-end pipeline that predicts admission chances with 92% accuracy using Gradient Boosting regression.
Wrote the Python and pandas ETL, containerized the model with Docker, deployed it on AWS EC2 and S3, and set up GitHub Actions CI/CD for automated retraining.

Cyberbullying Text Classification.name: Cyberbullying Text Classification
bullets: Classified social media text into six cyberbullying classes with 99% precision and 98% F1 score.
Vectorized text with CountVectorizer and compared Random Forest, ANN, XGBoost, and Gradient Boosting models before selecting the best performer.

Anime Recommendation System.name: Anime Recommendation System
bullets: Built a multimodal recommender that blends text similarity with image similarity to suggest related titles.
Combined CountVectorizer and cosine similarity on text with CLIP image embeddings in PyTorch.

Retail Sales and Customer Behavior Dashb.name: Retail Sales and Customer Behavior Dashboard
bullets: Built a Tableau dashboard comparing current and prior-year Sales, Profit, Orders, Quantity, and Customers, surfacing seasonal demand patterns and underperforming product lines.
Added a year-select parameter, weekly trends, and year-over-year KPI indicators so business users can run their own analysis.

Criminal Case System Analysis.name: Criminal Case System Analysis
bullets: Mapped an 11-table case management dataset at the District Attorney's Office, repaired UTF-8 corruption across all 11 CSVs, and built a 48-check validation suite covering key uniqueness, referential integrity, join cardinality, and date sequencing.

Analyzed case processing in SAS (DATA step, PROC FREQ, PROC MEANS, Wilcoxon, Kruskal-Wallis, chi-square, PROC GLM regression) with a Python reference implementation, flagging data quality exceptions before reporting.

LLM-Powered Shipment Support Assistant.name: LLM-Powered Shipment Support Assistant
bullets: Built a retrieval-augmented assistant that answers shipping, tracking, delivery exception, and service policy questions from large collections of logistics documents.
Indexed documents with text chunking, embeddings, and FAISS vector search, and evaluated retrieval accuracy, response relevance, latency, and hallucination rate.

E-Commerce Platform Database.name: E-Commerce Platform Database
bullets: Designed a normalized MySQL database with a MongoDB document store that simulates retail and supply chain transactions, then analyzed sales and inventory data to find process bottlenecks.
Built ER diagrams, keys, and user permissions, and wrote stored procedures that automate order and inventory operations.

Resume and Job Description Metadata Extr.name: Resume and Job Description Metadata Extraction
Resume and Job Description Metadata Extr.tools: Python, OpenAI GPT-4, Embeddings API, FAISS, LangChain
bullets: Built a tool that extracts structured metadata from resumes and job descriptions with OpenAI GPT-4 and matches them by semantic similarity.
Stored embeddings in FAISS and orchestrated extraction and retrieval steps with LangChain.
